paper_title: DLP Dynamic Layerwise Pruning in Large Language Models
caption: WikiText validation perplexity of LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B and Vicuna-7B pruned by various M at 70% sparsity using OWL.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The chart illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity of three large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—as a function of the pruning parameter M, applied at 70% sparsity using the OWL method. It displays three distinct lines, each representing one model, plotted against M values ranging from 3 to 8.

The horizontal axis (X-axis) is labeled "M" and uses a linear scale. The values are evenly spaced integers from 3 to 8, inclusive. There are no units indicated for M.

The vertical axis (Y-axis) is labeled "Perplexity" and uses a linear scale. The range of values spans from 20.0 to 40.0. The tick marks are spaced at intervals of 10.0, with labeled values at 20.0, 30.0, and 40.0.

The green line, representing LLaMA1-7B, starts at a perplexity of approximately 28.0 when M=3, decreases to a minimum of approximately 26.0 at M=5, remains relatively flat until M=7, then increases to approximately 36.0 at M=8.

The orange line, representing LLaMA1-13B, begins at a perplexity of approximately 19.0 when M=3, decreases slightly to approximately 18.0 at M=4, remains nearly constant at around 18.0 until M=6, then increases to approximately 19.0 at M=8.

The blue line, representing Vicuna-7B, starts at a perplexity of 40.0 when M=3, decreases to approximately 36.0 at M=4, continues to decline gradually to approximately 34.0 at M=5, remains relatively flat until M=7, then increases to approximately 40.0 at M=8.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart displays the WikiText validation perplexity for three large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—after being pruned using a dynamic layerwise pruning method (DLP) with varying values of M, at a 70% sparsity level. The x-axis, labeled "M", represents the pruning parameter and is plotted on a linear scale ranging from 3 to 8, with integer tick marks at each whole number. The y-axis, labeled "Perplexity", is also on a linear scale, ranging from 20.0 to 40.0, with tick marks at intervals of 10.0. The green line with circular markers represents LLaMA1-7B, starting at a perplexity of approximately 28.0 at M=3, decreasing to about 26.0 at M=4, remaining relatively stable near 26.0 until M=6, then rising to approximately 36.0 at M=8. The orange line with star markers represents LLaMA1-13B, starting at approximately 20.0 at M=3, decreasing slightly to about 19.0 at M=4, remaining nearly flat around 19.0 until M=6, and then increasing to about 20.5 at M=8. The blue line with triangular markers represents Vicuna-7B, starting at 40.0 at M=3, decreasing to about 36.0 at M=4, remaining relatively stable near 36.0 until M=7, then increasing to approximately 40.0 at M=8.
model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the WikiText validation perplexity for three large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—when pruned using a dynamic layerwise pruning method (DLP) with varying values of M, at a 70% sparsity level using the OWL technique. The x-axis, labeled “M”, represents the pruning parameter and ranges from 3 to 8, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis, labeled “Perplexity”, is scaled linearly and ranges from 20.0 to 40.0, with tick marks at intervals of 10.0. The plot displays three distinct lines: the LLaMA1-7B model is represented by a green line with circular markers that starts at a perplexity of approximately 28.5 at M=3, dips to about 27.0 at M=4, remains relatively stable near 27.0 until M=6, then rises to about 29.0 at M=7 and 31.0 at M=8; the LLaMA1-13B model is shown as an orange line with star-shaped markers that begins at approximately 19.5 at M=3, decreases slightly to about 19.0 at M=4, and then remains nearly flat around 19.0 until M=7, before rising to about 20.0 at M=8; the Vicuna-7B model is depicted by a blue line with triangular markers that starts at approximately 40.0 at M=3, decreases to about 37.0 at M=4, remains relatively stable near 37.0 until M=7, then rises to about 38.0 at M=7 and 40.0 at M=8.
model_annotations.German: This line chart displays the WikiText validation perplexity of three large language models—LLaMA1-7B, LLaMA1-13B, and Vicuna-7B—pruned at varying levels of sparsity (denoted by M) using the OWL method, with all models pruned to 70% sparsity. The x-axis represents the pruning level M, scaled linearly from 3 to 8, with tick labels at integer intervals and no unit specified. The y-axis represents perplexity, scaled linearly from 20.0 to 40.0, with tick labels at intervals of 10.0. The LLaMA1-7B model is represented by a green line with circular markers, starting at a perplexity of approximately 28.0 at M=3 and ending at approximately 36.0 at M=8, showing a consistent upward trend. The LLaMA1-13B model is represented by an orange line with star markers, starting at approximately 20.0 at M=3 and ending at approximately 21.5 at M=8, remaining relatively flat with minor fluctuations. The Vicuna-7B model is represented by a blue line with triangular markers, starting at approximately 40.0 at M=3, decreasing to approximately 34.0 at M=5, then stabilizing around 34.0 until M=7 before increasing again to approximately 40.0 at M=8.
